---
title: "Product Outcomes"
doc-type: reference
---

These outcomes describe who the product serves and what successful behavior means. Exact command behavior belongs in reference docs and source; delivery status belongs in `PLAN.md`.

## Generate A New Repository

A developer can create a self-contained repository with explicit instructions, selected profiles and skills, project documentation, a plan, and Bootstrap Metadata. The generated result can be inspected and verified without depending on a live Reference Source.

## Adopt Defaults Safely

A maintainer can inspect an existing repository, preview selected additions, preserve user-owned conflicts, and apply only the reviewed asset groups. Recorded ownership matches files actually written or explicitly adopted.

## Understand Provenance And Drift

A maintainer can identify the Reference Source, selected template and options, generated assets, checksums, Managed Surfaces, and operation history. Read-only checks distinguish stable generated content from edits, missing paths, and conflicts.

## Choose Agent Support Explicitly

A project can select harnesses, model defaults, tools, advisory profiles, and vendored skills without embedding credentials or machine-level configuration in repository assets.

## Review Plans And Decisions

Humans and agents can find canonical domain language, current priorities, durable decisions, architecture rationale, and implementation/test routing before changing code.
